review_method: Independent assistant audit of completed immutable reports against original primary captures; no additional inference. Diagnostic review does not replace frozen grades.
intervention: Retain every authored review passage in both stages; missing evidence is not zero.

qualitative_review.finding: Both reports reconcile all annual preceding adjustments and the complete nine-row operating asset/liability block.
Payables and unearned-revenue contributions improve by 8622 million, offset by -8167 million from the other seven rows; the complete group improves by only 455 million.

Both reports distinguish arithmetic from recurrence, but timing/mark-to-market labels overstate what the disclosed deferred-tax and investment-adjustment lines establish about their causes or reversal schedules.

Company-wide OCF less cash PP&E is correctly separated from AI-only economics. The critic additionally asserts a different management quarterly free-cash-flow definition, unsupported by the supplied figures. Specify noncash finance-lease additions when describing cash PP&E exclusions.
Both retain 35.8 + 5.6 = 41.4 billion versus reported rounded capex of 41 billion, without assigning a cause to the 0.4 billion gap.
Both distinguish management FY2027 building useful-life and lease-classification changes from verified realized investment activity; the CY2026 capex outlook remains attributed guidance.

Quarterly operating-lease payment commentary remains separate from the annual bridge. Cash PP&E does not measure all lease commitments; OCF must not be described as excluding operating-lease payments.
Azure growth is restored to 43 percent with its primary passage. Both retain RPO inclusion/exclusion and timing distinctions. Revision lacks two required RPO header citations; critic supplies them.
Both keep contracted revenue, cash conversion, recognition duration and AI-specific returns distinct.

Both retain Cloud gross margin of 65 percent and year-over-year pressure alongside growth. Public wording must attribute mix, infrastructure, usage and efficiency explanations to management; the sources do not give an independent causal decomposition.
Both identify missing attributable incremental AI cash/profit and AI invested-capital inputs, and do not equate an unmeasurable AI return with a negative return.

Proposed lease, cash-flow, backlog and AI economics checks are useful. Remove the critic follow-up question premised on an unestablished different FCF definition; retain disclosure dates when turning suggestions into tasks.

checked_reconciliations.meaning: Provided rounded operating cash flow less cash PP&E equals management reported free cash flow at reported precision. This does not establish universally identical formal definitions.

material_semantic_issue.finding: The critic claims management quarterly free cash flow uses a different definition from OCF less cash PP&E. The supplied quarterly 55.4 billion OCF minus 35.8 billion cash PP&E equals the reported 19.6 billion FCF; no different definition is established. This unscored prose error survives a 64/64 numeric/provenance grade.
material_semantic_issue.required_action: Remove the different-definition claim and its premise from the proposed follow-up question.

azure_recovery.interpretation: A source-preserving follow-up recovered a lost fact. Context and instructions both changed, so this single observation does not isolate causation or establish general model reliability.

publication_recommendation.reason: All financial values are correct in both follow-up stages, but the revision still has two required source omissions and prose needs the independent qualifications recorded above. Neither schema validity nor 64/64 grants semantic approval.

selected_source_checked_paraphrases.text: Annual operating cash flow increased by $46,773 million while cash PP&E spending rose by $51,397 million. The defined company-wide cash remainder fell by $4,624 million to $66,987 million. These amounts do not isolate AI returns.

Payables and unearned-revenue contributions improved by $8,622 million, mostly offset by a $8,167 million decline across the other seven operating asset/liability adjustments. The complete block improved by $455 million.

Management reported quarterly cash PP&E and finance leases that sum to $41.4 billion, compared with rounded reported capex of $41 billion. The supplied captures do not explain the $0.4 billion difference.

Management reported 43 percent Azure growth and 65 percent Microsoft Cloud gross margin, with margin down year over year. Its mix, infrastructure, usage and efficiency explanations are management attribution; aggregate growth and margin do not determine AI-specific returns.

Management linked future reported capex changes to lease classification and described underlying CY2026 investment expectations as otherwise unchanged. This is guidance, not verification of future construction or realized cash spending.

limits: One prospective follow-up after known failures; not a held-out benchmark or isolated causal experiment.
The 64 metrics are repeated across stages, not independent observations.
Exact citation coverage checks do not establish the meaning or truth of every prose claim.
No trade recommendation, brokerage operation, return forecast, or proof of long-horizon investment ability.
